report.title: Filtering with tags no longer shows sub-tagged Memos
report.body:
### Describe the bug

Say I have 2 tags, "#House" and "#House/Garden". Previously, filtering by "#House" would show Memos that were tagged "#House" AND "#House/Garden". Now, it's completely explicit, so only the selected tag shows up and no sub-tags are included.

This feature was useful for drilling down in specificity of Memos, especially once your server gets into the hundreds of Memos, I'd quite like to see it come back if this was an intentional change.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a Memo with "#Tag/Subtag"
- Filter the Memos by "#Tag"
- Memos with "#Tag/Subtag" do not appear in the results

### The version of Memos you're using


v0.25.1

### Screenshots or additional context

_No response_

preconditions: no memos exist yet in a fresh install
the tag sidebar lists tags found in memos
steps: Click the memo editor on the home page
Click the Save button to create the memo
In the tag list in the sidebar, click the "Tag" tag to filter memos by it
plan.expected: After filtering by the tag "Tag", the memo containing "#Tag/Subtag" is visible in the memo list.
plan.reported_actual: Filtering by "#Tag" shows only memos tagged exactly "#Tag"; the memo tagged "#Tag/Subtag" does not appear in the results.
missing: assumed: the filter is applied by clicking the parent tag "Tag" in the sidebar tag list (the report does not say how the filter is applied)
assumed: the sidebar tag list shows "Tag" as a parent node of "Subtag" after the memo is saved
Does the issue also occur when a memo tagged exactly "#Tag" exists alongside the sub-tagged memo?
Was the change from the previous behavior intentional (which version did it last work in)?
plan.summary: Filtering by a parent tag no longer includes memos tagged with its sub-tags (e.g. #Tag/Subtag)
